title: Software Engineering Internship
description: Join our engineering team and work on cutting-edge full-stack applications. You will collaborate with experienced engineers on real-world projects while learning industry best practices.
requirements: Currently enrolled in BSc Computer Science, BSc Information Technology, or related field. Knowledge of JavaScript, React, and Node.js is beneficial. Strong communication skills and passion for learning.

title: Graduate Data Science Program
description: Fast-track your data science career with our intensive graduate program. Work on real datasets, learn machine learning, and join a network of top data professionals.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field. Knowledge of Python and SQL. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Frontend Development Internship
description: Work with our creative team building responsive user interfaces. Collaborate with designers and backend developers to deliver engaging web experiences.
requirements: Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Experience with React or Vue.js. Attention to detail and understanding of UX principles.

title: Business Analyst Graduate Program
description: Structured program for commerce graduates entering the business consulting space. Mentorship from senior analysts and exposure to diverse industry challenges.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, or related field. Excellent written and verbal communication. Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

title: Mobile App Development Internship
description: Build native and cross-platform mobile applications. Learn best practices in app development, testing, and deployment. Work with modern frameworks and tools.
requirements: Knowledge of Swift, Kotlin, React Native, or Flutter. Familiarity with mobile development principles. Keen to learn and collaborate with the team.

title: Financial Services Graduate Program
description: Comprehensive program for commerce graduates looking to build careers in financial services. Training in financial analysis, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or Economics. Strong numerical skills. Interest in financial markets and investment.
